source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of user feedback (PDF 190-191).

items: Surveys aur forms: mawad behtar karne ke liye users ki raye jama karna, maslan naye website ke tajurbe ke baare mein visitors se poochna.
Seedha rabta: users se un ki zarooraton par baat karna, maslan presentation par hum jamaaton ki raye lena.

blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq 2020 mein Pakistan ne Personal Data Protection Bill pesh kiya, jo idaron se zaati data jama karne se pehle wazeh raza aur mehfooz rakhne ka taqaza karta (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Mawad accessible banane ke baad users se feedback kyun lein?
blocks.explanation: Asal users, maazoor afraad samait, woh masail batate hain jo banane wale ko nazar nahi aaye.

items: Surveys aur seedhi baat cheet se user feedback digital mawad behtar karta hai.
